newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Exploration boosted by acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Exploration boosted by acquisitions.

text.p: United States Exploration Inc on Monday attributed its improved December 31 third-quarter results to recent acquisitions and addititonal development work made possible by fresh working capital.

The company completed the acquisition of Performance Petroleum Corp and Pacific Osage Inc in September 1995. Oil and gas production associated with those acquisitions, together with more recent additions, have contributed to the increase in revenues and profitability, it said.

Improvement in the company's financial condition reflects a private placement of equity securities completed in the third quarter. U.S. Exploration sold four million shares of Seires C preferred. Gross proceeds were $24 million.
For the third quarter, the company posted a profit of $248,000 compared with a loss of $151,000 in the year-earlier period.
On a per share basis, it recorded a loss of $0.01 per share, after payment of preferred dividends, compared with a loss of $0.05 per share in the same quarter the previous year.
